references.text: The children of Gad and Reuben reaffirm their commitment to do as the Lord has commanded Moses, demonstrating their obedience to the covenant.
Moses describes what the Lord commands, and the children of Gad and Reuben respond that they will obey this command.
The tribes confirm their obedience to Joshua in the same way they promised Moses, saying they will do everything he commands.
The people of Israel answer unanimously that they will do all that the Lord has said, a similar promise of obedience.
The people promise to do all that the Lord has commanded, the same kind of pledge of obedience given by the children of Gad and Reuben.
The people ask Moses to hear God's words and convey them to them, promising to obey, showing a similar attitude of submission.
